params.notificationDataFormat: Service recovery plan execution status, allowed values: not started, ended; example: ended (required); Complaint diagnosis task sequence number; example: 9de168c0-6179-4778-8b72-4279582c0a3f (required); OSS-side event sequence number; example: event-id-202606250128 (required); Access port name; example: P781-珠江新城-PTN7900-23-TPA1EG24-17 (required); Whether OMC automatic recovery is authorized, allowed values: yes, no; example: yes (required); Service recovery plan name; example: tunnel tuning (required); Service recovery plan details (required); Service recovery plan execution end time; example: 2026-05-11T08:21:46Z (optional); Service recovery plan execution result, allowed values: success, failure; example: success (optional); Service recovery plan execution failure reason; required when the execution result is failure; example: link C is occupied after tuning, unable to perform tunnel tuning (optional)
